source_snapshot.items: Test connections among FPGA1, FPGA1 EROT, HMC I2C-4, HMC FRU and BMC I2C-3
source_snapshot.procedure: From BMC bus2 runs broad quick-write scan and `i2ctransfer -y 2 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: No0x11 identity,0x0400 semantics, expected three bytes or hop oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; substitutes physical probing for explicit functional transaction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags write phase but retains physical-only coverage and lacks chain attribution.

old_problem: BMC I2C-3-to-bus2 mapping,0x11 owner,0x0400 pointer/read semantics, three-byte decoder and evidence that the reply covers FPGA1/EROT/HMC I2C-4/FRU are absent; broad scan safety and recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: The combined read is a viable gated functional test, not Manual Only, but ED-03 prohibits guessing OEM address/register meanings or multi-hop coverage. Pending/Requires Confirmation remains until PID/vendor documentation defines safe access, reply fields and each named hop.
decision_basis: Read row130/history2520 and kept BMC bus2/BMC I2C-3 distinct from row131 HMC bus3 despite shared0x11/0x0400.
Preserved all named components and literal combined transaction.
Rejected broad quick-write scan without per-address safety and invented probe/solder/photo acceptance.
Required an authoritative three-byte decoder, hop-to-field matrix and any separate FRU content read.
No scan, combined transaction, component reset, physical probe, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-3 to FPGA1/EROT/HMC/FRU functional chain
test_case.purpose: Use the approved bus2 address0x11 register0x0400 read to verify the named BMC I2C-3–FPGA1–EROT–HMC I2C-4–FRU chain through component-specific decoded evidence, without unsafe discovery.
required_package: PID1114953 hop-by-hop topology and BMC I2C-3-to-bus2 mapping
Vendor0x0400 combined-read semantics and three-byte field decoder
Coverage matrix showing which fields prove each hop plus any separate safe FRU read
Bus owner/safe scan policy, timeout/NACK limits, BMC/HMC recovery and health checks
test_case.test_command: Do not run broad `i2cdetect -q`. After protocol/ownership approval, capture component/bus/error baseline, execute one bounded `i2ctransfer -y 2 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`, preserve status/latency, decode each byte against the signed oracle, correlate component status and stop without automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact0x11/0x0400 transaction returns the signed three-byte values/masks within bounds, component-specific evidence demonstrates every required FPGA1/EROT/HMC/FRU hop (or approved supplemental FRU read), and no new bus/component/management error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires address/register identity, decoded expected fields and hop coverage. An ACK/arbitrary three bytes, unsafe scan, unexpected value/length, NACK/timeout/arbitration loss, missing FRU proof or new component error fails; physical photos are not required absent separate scope.
safety_gate: Confirm0x0400 is a non-mutating pointer/read for exact0x11 device.
Coordinate bus2 owner/daemon and independent management recovery.
No broad quick-write discovery or unknown register writes.
One bounded read; stop on any error or management degradation without retry.
expected_evidence: PID hop topology and BMC I2C-3/bus2 map
BMC/FPGA1/EROT/HMC/FRU identities and bus owner baseline
Timestamped transaction, status/latency and decoded expected-observed matrix
Per-component status/error/log correlation and any approved FRU evidence
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected if the pointer/read semantics are correct. On failure preserve logs and stop; use owner recovery only if bus/components degrade. Do not scan, reset or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: A multi-hop claim has only an undecoded reply and no bus mapping; prior reviews add unsupported physical-only work.

blocked.reason: The candidate functional transaction is known; authoritative mapping/decoder/coverage and safe access are resolvable RPUC inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: PID hop map,0x11 identity,0x0400 safe semantics/decoder, per-component coverage, ownership/error limits and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the bus/register protocol and hop-specific response oracle, then revise or run the single bounded read.

project_authority: PID1114953 and vendor FPGA/EROT/HMC register documentation define the OEM path and response semantics.
